title: Go
description: Go projects: the Go toolchain mounted in; the module proxy and checksum database, Go's downloads and GitHub open, everything else closed.

de.title: Go
de.description: Go-Projekte: die Go-Toolchain eingehängt; der Modul-Proxy und die Prüfsummen-Datenbank, Gos Downloads und GitHub offen, alles andere zu.

notes: The toolchain (go, gofmt) comes with the preset (--toolchain go): from sandbox-ai's signed toolchains, mounted read-only at /opt/toolchains (nothing to install in the sandbox). Not in the store yet, the start offers to add it (sandbox-ai toolchain add go: a download, its signature and SHA-256 checked) - on a terminal it asks, with --fix it does, the app asks in its window. Its registries are the ones this preset opens.
A newer Go a go.mod asks for (its toolchain line) comes from the module proxy into the sandbox's HOME; cgo needs a C compiler: --toolchain cc on the command line.
Modules outside the proxy (private ones, GOPROXY=direct) need their host: --allow-host NAME on the command line.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
